title: Penguin dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- dance floor glow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='91' rx='30' ry='6' fill='#2a4a7a'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='91' rx='20' ry='3.5' fill='#3b6fb0'/>
  <!-- music notes floating -->
  <g fill='#ffd76a'>
    <path d='M20 26 L20 14 L28 12 L28 16 L23 17.5 L23 26 Z'/>
    <circle cx='17.5' cy='27' r='3.5'/>
    <path d='M78 20 L78 8 L86 6 L86 10 L81 11.5 L81 20 Z'/>
    <circle cx='75.5' cy='21' r='3.5'/>
  </g>
  <!-- left flipper raised -->
  <path d='M36 48 Q20 38 14 28 Q18 46 30 56 Z' fill='#2c4a70'/>
  <!-- right flipper raised -->
  <path d='M64 48 Q80 38 86 28 Q82 46 70 56 Z' fill='#2c4a70'/>
  <!-- left foot kicked up -->
  <path d='M40 84 Q30 82 24 74 Q32 76 40 80 Z' fill='#ff9f43'/>
  <!-- right foot planted -->
  <path d='M60 84 Q70 84 76 90 Q68 92 60 90 Z' fill='#ff9f43'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='64' rx='21' ry='26' fill='#46618f'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='67' rx='12' ry='18' fill='#eaf2ff'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='34' r='16' fill='#46618f'/>
  <!-- face patch -->
  <path d='M50 22 Q63 24 66 34 Q66 44 50 45 Q34 44 34 34 Q37 24 50 22 Z' fill='#eaf2ff'/>
  <!-- eyes happy -->
  <path d='M41 33 Q43.5 29 46 33' stroke='#1c2440' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M54 33 Q56.5 29 59 33' stroke='#1c2440' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- beak -->
  <path d='M46 38 L50 43 L54 38 Z' fill='#ff9f43'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='38' r='2.5' fill='#ff7b9c'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='38' r='2.5' fill='#ff7b9c'/>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#8fe3ff'>
    <path d='M12 58 L13.5 62 L17 63.5 L13.5 65 L12 69 L10.5 65 L7 63.5 L10.5 62 Z'/>
    <path d='M88 66 L89.5 70 L93 71.5 L89.5 73 L88 77 L86.5 73 L83 71.5 L86.5 70 Z'/>
  </g>
</svg>
